settings.heading: Freshwater livestock, graded and ready to ship
settings.copy: We supply aquarium retailers, pet chains and aquascaping studios with healthy freshwater fish and hard goods. Trade accounts see live stock counts, size grades and your own pricing.
settings.snapshot_note: Counts update as orders are picked

settings.heading: Shop by category
settings.subheading: Livestock is grouped the way you order it — by type, then by size grade.

settings.heading: Available now
settings.subheading: Counts are live. Anything showing limited stock is close to selling out for this dispatch.

settings.title: Graded before it is bagged
settings.text: Fish are sized, counted and checked by hand on the morning they ship, so what arrives matches the grade you ordered.

settings.title: Pricing that holds
settings.text: Your account price is fixed for the quarter with volume breaks at 10, 50 and 100 units. No surprise surcharges at invoice.

settings.title: Two dispatch runs a week
settings.text: Livestock leaves Tuesday and Wednesday on overnight air freight to all capital cities, with a live arrival guarantee.

settings.title: Stock you can plan around
settings.text: Counts on this site come from the same system our packers use, and breeding runs are listed weeks ahead.
Registered Australian business or NZ equivalent
Payment terms available after three orders

settings.heading: Open a trade account
settings.copy: Pricing and stock counts are visible to approved trade customers only. Send through your ABN and we will usually have you set up within one business day.
